Carbohydrate
Refined carbohydrates are also known to be calciuric, but those high in fiber are anticalciuric. Thus, 
a diet lower in simple sugars and products made from refined flour, but higher in complex carbo­
hydrates made from whole grains, as well as fresh fruits and vegetables, is recommended.
